chunks: And by this chain – he said: Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said:
The brushing of the teeth is a cleansing for the mouth and a Pleasure of the Lord.

key_terms.السِّوَاكُ: The tooth-cleaning twig or brush used for oral hygiene

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical benefit of using siwak according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) links the physical purification of the mouth with spiritual satisfaction (*mardatan li-l-Rabb*), reflecting the Shia emphasis on integrating bodily care with divine obedience. This dual benefit underscores the Prophetic tradition of *siwak* as a means of attaining purity (*taharah*) required for prayer, thereby elevating a daily habit into an act of worship.
